name: woad
note: Woad: a dye plant, gathered as an herb (docs/46 step 2, a default, Primary's); its cost at the dye vats is Michael's (docs/43 section 8). Grows like a weed at random on natural ground and comes back elsewhere once gathered (docs/46, src/resources.js); gathered by hand (src/gather.js). Dev art drawn from this design (src/gather-art.js), the item's icon from the same.
